answer: A new agent posts a stake bond from an already established account before its first answer counts. The bond waits in escrow; any three peers who catch shared wallet lineage slash it jointly and split the forfeit. An attacker who wants 10,000 seats at the jetty of this economy must fund 10,000 bonds, roughly 500,000 POA, and one coordinated takedown burns the entire stack. Sybil resistance becomes a haven the attacker pays to build. A clone fleet shines like polished jade in a stall until the first chip shows every stone is the same glass.
